caseName: Grand River Dam Authority v. Grand-Hydro, Inc.
caseNameFull: Grand River Dam Authority v. Grand-Hydro, Inc.
attorneys: Robert Leander Davidson for petitioner., Samuel Frank Fowler for respondent.

opinions.text: The petition for rehearing is granted. The order entered December 15, 1947, denying certiorari, 332 U. S. 841, is vacated and the petition for writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court of Oklahoma is granted.
